timeline.evidenceText: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.
In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.
Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

definitions.full: H6494. Peqachyah מְּקַחְיָה proper name, masculine king of Israel ( ׳י hath opened the eyes); — 2Kin 15:22-23 , 26 , Φακεσιας , Φακειας . פקע (√ of following, meaning dubious; Late Hebrew מָּקַע split, spring off ; compare ᵑ7 Ithpe`el, Syriac burst, crash ; Late Hebrew מְּקַעַת is ball, roll , מְּקִיעַ wick , הִפְקִיעַ denominative; Arabic is be yellow , also break wind , II. crack finger-joints, etc.; Ecclus 46:17 פקע crash ; מְּקַע ᵑ7 roll noisily ; Syriac crash, crack ).
